title: AI Structural Shifts: Scaling Agents, Decision‑Model Rollouts, and a $1.25T Valuation
core_insight: OpenAI’s $30 B fundraising at a $1.25 T valuation, together with its decision‑model release and massive multi‑agent deployments, marks a consolidation of AI power into high‑valuation, enterprise‑focused platforms.

dimension_texts.technology: OpenAI 发布决策模型（Jev 竞争者）以及 DeepMind Gemini 3.8 Live 的扩展思考能力，提升了多模态推理和长上下文处理；AlphaGenome Atlas 展示了基因变异预测的全基因组规模能力。 Google AI 引入 Retrieve‑for‑Train 通过检索加速训练/推理，降低算力需求；DeepMind 私有 AI Compute 引入安全服务器端内存；OpenAI 通过成千上万的 AI 代理在生物数据上进行大规模探索。 Introducing Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking Bypassing inference bottlenecks: Accelerating complex AI search with Retrieve-for-Train AlphaGenome Atlas: A predictive map of every possible DNA letter change in the human genome OpenAI makes its Jev competitor widely available as decision model competition heats up Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data
dimension_texts.infrastructure: Retrieve‑for‑Train 与 FP8 量化模型（DeepSeek‑V4.1‑Flash‑FP8）显著降低了检索‑增强推理和大模型部署的算力开销。 Nvidia 继续成为自动驾驶和机器人领域的关键算力供应商；未见新硬件发布，但对 GPU 需求因 inDrive 与 Pony AI 合作而上升。 Bypassing inference bottlenecks: Accelerating complex AI search with Retrieve-for-Train dealignai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-UNCENSORED-FP8 Uber rival inDrive eyes 2027 robotaxi tests in Central Asia with Pony AI and Nvidia
dimension_texts.application: AI 进入生物医药（大规模代理发现基因线索、AlphaGenome 基因变异预测）、气象（WeatherNext 3）、自动驾驶（inDrive 机器人出租车）、教育（生成式 UI 教学工具）以及网络安全（ChatGPT 广告、1Password AI 登录）。 ChatGPT 广告堆栈开始取代传统搜索/展示广告；1Password AI 登录取代手动凭证输入；OpenAI 决策模型挑战传统决策平台（如 Jev）。 ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries as over 100,000 advertisers have used the platform AlphaGenome Atlas: A predictive map of every possible DNA letter change in the human genome Introducing WeatherNext 3, our most advanced and accurate global weather AI model Uber rival inDrive eyes 2027 robotaxi tests in Central Asia with Pony AI and Nvidia
